method: Direct visual inspection of PDF pages 37–40 (one-based), paraphrases only; no independent human signoff or Cangjie run.

records.summary_en: The verse describes a composite ideal across many facial regions, rather than one isolated feature.
records.summary_zh: 本段综合额、鼻、口、颧等部位描述传统相貌理想。

records.summary_en: The five-element scheme introduces distinct body-form categories.
records.summary_zh: 五行形以不同形体作为分类依据。

records.summary_en: The text treats elemental categories as composite forms and allows different shapes within each category.
records.summary_zh: 五形象说讨论综合形体，并非所有形体都以同一标准衡量。

records.summary_en: The metal archetype is associated with firmness in the historical account.
records.summary_zh: 原文在金形论述中使用刚毅观念。

records.summary_en: The fire archetype is associated with decisiveness in the historical account.
records.summary_zh: 原文在火形论述中使用机果观念。

records.summary_en: The verse links a fully realized metal archetype with renown.
records.summary_zh: 金形诗将入格与名扬相联。

records.summary_en: The wood archetype verse contains an auspicious reference to later life.
records.summary_zh: 木形诗中有晚景吉祥的意象。

records.summary_en: The water archetype verse includes a traditional association with lifelong prosperity.
records.summary_zh: 水形诗中有平生富足的传统意象。

records.summary_en: The historical text associates its composite fire archetype with impatience and restless behavior.
records.summary_zh: 火形论述含躁急、举止不定等传统评价。

records.summary_en: The earth archetype verse invokes steadiness and trustworthiness as traditional ideals.
records.summary_zh: 土形诗以安详、信义等观念描述传统理想。

records.summary_en: The chapter uses natural imagery to explain the classical idea of bodily form.
records.summary_zh: 论形以天地自然意象解释传统形体观。

records.summary_en: The chapter treats form, vitality and spirit as interconnected within its historical theory.
records.summary_zh: 论神讨论形、血、气、神相互关联的古代理论。

limitations: Composite historical archetypes are not valid personal character assessments.
No runtime changes; no independent human review.
